title: Evidence
description: Specific text passage or metadata extracted from a cited source to verify a claim.

id.description: Unique UUID of the evidence item

paper_id.description: Foreign key to the source ResearchPaper

source_provider.description: Scholarly provider name (e.g. crossref, openalex, europe_pmc)

url.description: Accessible web URL to source paper or repository

passage.description: Exact excerpt from the abstract or full-text used for verification

similarity_score.description: Semantic similarity score between the claim and this passage
